criteria.notes: The word 'only' is exclusionary: any additional lesion type disqualifies mild NPDR. No count threshold is given for microaneurysms at any level.

criteria.verbatim: Microaneurysms and other signs (e.g., dot and blot hemorrhages, hard exudates, cotton wool spots), but less than severe nonproliferative DR
criteria.notes: Negatively defined at its upper bound. The lesion list is introduced by 'e.g.' and is therefore non-exhaustive, which is the main source of ambiguity in this level.

criteria.source: Table 1, Severe nonproliferative DR row, stem
criteria.verbatim: Moderate nonproliferative DR with any of the following:

criteria.source: Table 1, Severe nonproliferative DR row, bullet 1
criteria.notes: 'each quadrant' implies all four quadrants must independently meet the threshold. The comparator here is >=20; the commonly cited ICDR variant is 'more than 20 ... in each of 4 quadrants', i.e. >20. Off-by-one matters at exactly 20.

criteria.source: Table 1, Severe nonproliferative DR row, bullet 2
criteria.notes: The qualifier 'definite' is load-bearing: equivocal beading does not qualify. This table states 'in 2 quadrants'; the commonly cited ICDR variant is '2 or more quadrants'. Beading confined to one quadrant does not establish severe NPDR.

criteria.source: Table 1, Severe nonproliferative DR row, bullet 3
criteria.notes: Threshold is one quadrant, so any confidently identified IRMA reaches severe NPDR. The commonly cited ICDR variant adds the qualifier 'prominent'; this table does not. Absence of that qualifier makes this the criterion most likely to cause over-grading.

criteria.source: Table 1, Severe nonproliferative DR row, bullet 4
criteria.verbatim: and no signs of proliferative retinopathy
criteria.notes: Printed as a bullet under 'any of the following' but functions as a conjunct exclusion; see extraction_notes.structural_ambiguity.

criteria.verbatim: Severe nonproliferative DR and 1 or more of the following: Neovascularization; Vitreous/preretinal hemorrhage
criteria.notes: Stem requires severe NPDR as the base state, then either sign is independently sufficient. No quadrant or extent threshold is specified for neovascularisation.

criteria.source: Table 1, DME sub-table, No DME row
criteria.verbatim: No retinal thickening or hard exudates in the macula

criteria.source: Table 1, DME sub-table, Noncentral-involved DME row
criteria.verbatim: Retinal thickening in the macula that does not involve the central subfield zone that is 1mm in diameter

criteria.source: Table 1, DME sub-table, Central-involved DME row
criteria.verbatim: Retinal thickening in the macula that does involve the central subfield zone that is 1mm in diameter

extraction_notes.known_threshold_discrepancy: The ICDR table in this PDF states 'Intraretinal hemorrhages (>=20 in each quadrant)', 'Definite venous beading (in 2 quadrants)' and 'Intraretinal microvascular abnormalities (in 1 quadrant)'. The widely reproduced ICDR wording is 'more than 20 intraretinal hemorrhages in each of 4 quadrants', 'definite venous beading in 2+ quadrants' and 'prominent IRMA in 1+ quadrant'. Per instruction, the table as supplied is treated as authoritative and the variant is recorded in notes.
extraction_notes.structural_ambiguity: The severe NPDR row lists 'and no signs of proliferative retinopathy' as a fourth bullet under 'any of the following'. Read literally this makes it a disjunct, which is incoherent. It is encoded here as a required conjunct (c_005), consistent with the standard reading.
